openings.claim: Dated, standalone printed preparation may reduce stale-task confusion.
openings.probe: Counterbalance current/revised layouts with equivalent examples; track identification, blanks, attendance and coordination for six sessions.
openings.uncertainty: Requires task fixed before printing and little added work.

openings.claim: Fresh shared prompts plus alternating timed turns may improve entry and speaking access while preserving routine.
openings.discriminator: Less entry difficulty and higher minimum partner airtime; usefulness must also improve.
openings.probe: Reverse matched ordinary/package round order across pairs; observe turns, usefulness, entry difficulty and setup burden.
openings.uncertainty: Comparable difficulty and feasible cues assumed; package cannot isolate components.

openings.claim: Standalone prompts, private optional paper scaffolds and reciprocal turns may jointly make protected opportunities useful.
openings.discriminator: Combined useful-speaking gain exceeds summed component gains, especially with unfamiliar topics; airtime inequality falls.
openings.probe: Rotate consenting pairs through scaffold-only, turns-only, combined and incumbent conditions over six sessions; sample durations, usefulness, familiarity and effort. Allocate two six-minute turns per participant.
openings.uncertainty: Scaffold suitability, useful protected time and workload feasibility unproven.

openings.claim: Dated paper plus partner restatement may correct interpretation and preserve preparation recall; standalone arrival instructions support absences.
openings.discriminator: Combination beats paper on stale answers and restatement on later recall.
openings.probe: Compare components/combination using unprompted exit answers, next-arrival recall, corrections, clarification requests and coordination minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Accurate partner checks and brief handoff assumed; preparation remains optional.

decision: Retain four hypotheses; causes and success remain unproven. Preserve free access, no attendance/label exclusion, offline preparation, conversational purpose, one 75-minute room and unpaid resources. Verify six-session 80% useful-speaking/85% preparation targets and coordination below 90 minutes. Slips cover 72/97 attendances; speaking distribution and workload components remain unmeasured. Routine is valued; partner changes do not prove proficiency mismatch.
